title: Dependency reach view
description: Ephemeral derived Insight ViewModel from traust-core's dependency-reach view: what the scope's latest default-branch manifest SBOMs hold, per ecosystem and by how many repositories share each package. It reads the latest manifests, so Core refuses an as_of. Not a persisted artifact or SQL projection. Every serialized field is present; lists are never null. JSON Schema checks structure and ranges, not arithmetic across fields.

unmeasured.description: Of those, the ones with no manifest SBOM at their default-branch commit: not measured, not dependency-free.

ecosystems.description: One row per ecosystem the manifests hold, most repositories first, then by ecosystem.

shared.description: The 25 most shared packages, most repositories first, then by ecosystem and name.

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem as stored (non-empty; intake classifies it with the ecosystem registry).

repositories.description: Repositories whose manifests hold at least one of its packages.

packages.description: Distinct packages of the ecosystem across the manifests.

package.description: A package and its blast radius: the repositories whose manifests hold it.

ecosystem.description: The package ecosystem as stored (non-empty; intake classifies it with the ecosystem registry).

name.description: The package name as stored, raw (non-empty).
